title: The liveness baseline is taken at admission, so an adopted attempt always reads as idle
description:
dh1's probe baselines a worktree at newInflight — the moment THIS incarnation admits the attempt. That is right for an attempt this incarnation dispatched, and wrong for an ADOPTED one, which did its work under a previous incarnation, possibly an hour earlier.

The result is a true sentence that points the wrong way:

    attempt 7 of ef7 is alive but has produced nothing durable for 45m24s ...
    and it has written NOTHING into its worktree since the run first looked at it

ef7 attempt 7 had already FINISHED. Two minutes after that warning it answered DONE, merged a7501ffaa54c into epic/ncv, and passed both halves of the integrated gate. It had written nothing since the run first looked because the run first looked after the work was over.

The cost was not theoretical. The orchestrator read that line, plus the same line about k4s, plus herdr's ordinary wall-clock teardown warnings, and built a confident case that herdr was losing panes and starving workers. It was one step from restarting the herdr server — which would have killed roughly twenty unrelated sessions on this host — to fix a problem that did not exist.

So this is the same defect class the whole day has been about: a statement that is true, and that explains nothing, presented where an operator will act on it.

Work:
- An adopted attempt must carry a baseline from when it was DISPATCHED, not when it was adopted. The marker is durable and the executor's state root already holds per-attempt directories; one of them can carry the baseline so it survives the incarnation that took it.
- Where no baseline survives, the probe must say SO rather than inventing one from the adoption moment: 'no baseline from before this incarnation; idle time is measured from adoption and is not evidence about the agent'.
- The stall warning must not fire for an attempt whose report already exists — a worker that has answered is not stalled, whatever its worktree looks like.
- Test: adopt an attempt dispatched by a previous incarnation whose work is already complete; assert no stall warning, and that the liveness row is marked as having no pre-adoption baseline.

Found 2026-09-19, epic ncv, within an hour of dh1 landing. Related: dh1, ad4, rxe.
acceptance_criteria: An adopted attempt is never reported as idle on the strength of a baseline taken at adoption; a missing pre-adoption baseline is stated rather than substituted, and a test covers the adopted-and-already-finished case
